Grants the following after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon readied:
• 20 Reload Speed
• 5% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• ? Handling
• 5% decreased Handling Animation Duration

Sprinting refreshes the buff duration.

Being <arc/>Amplified removes the sprinting requirement and increases the Reload Speed stat bonus to 60.
